description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'CustomerSearchFilterParams' used for filtering customer search results within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends the base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties for customer name and IDs, along with getter and setter methods. The class also initializes a default sort field for search operations.

classes.name: CustomerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying filtering parameters when searching for customers, including name and customer IDs, with enforced allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting default sort field to 'customer.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the customer name filter value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the customer name filter value.

methods.name: getCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of customer IDs used for filtering.

methods.name: setCustomerIds
methods.description: Sets the array of customer IDs for filtering.
